tagline: Lakeside palaces, havelis and sunset boat rides in the City of Lakes
signatureFood: dal baati churma, laal maas, mawa kachori, gatte ki sabzi

seasons.label: Cool season
seasons.note: Best time to visit: clear lakes and comfortable sightseeing weather.

seasons.label: Hot season
seasons.note: Hot afternoons; keep sightseeing to mornings and evenings, and lakes may be lower.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Lakes fill up and the hills turn green; the most scenic time for Monsoon Palace, with intermittent rain.

places.name: City Palace Udaipur
places.desc: Sprawling lakeside palace complex with courtyards, balconies and museum galleries above Lake Pichola.

places.name: Lake Pichola Boat Ride
places.desc: Boat ride past the Lake Palace and Jag Mandir, best around sunset.

places.name: Jagdish Temple
places.desc: Intricately carved 17th-century Vishnu temple right beside City Palace.

places.name: Saheliyon ki Bari
places.desc: Royal garden of fountains, marble elephants and lotus pools built for palace ladies.

places.name: Fateh Sagar Lake Promenade
places.desc: Lakeside promenade with sunset views, street food and optional boating.

places.name: Monsoon Palace (Sajjangarh)
places.desc: Hilltop palace with panoramic views over Udaipur's lakes, popular near sunset.

places.name: Dharohar Folk Dance Show at Bagore ki Haveli
places.desc: Evening Rajasthani folk dance and puppet show inside an 18th-century haveli, with a small museum.

places.name: Vintage Car Museum
places.desc: Royal garage of Rolls-Royces, Cadillacs and other classic cars once owned by the Mewar family.

places.name: Lakeside Dinner at Ambrai Ghat
places.desc: Candlelit dinner on the ghat facing the illuminated City Palace across Lake Pichola.

places.name: Shilpgram Craft Village
places.desc: Open-air rural arts and crafts village with artisans, folk performances and handicraft stalls.

places.name: Ahar Cenotaphs
places.desc: Royal cenotaphs of Mewar rulers and an archaeological museum, usually uncrowded.
